choices.contrast_caveat: Own-weight planning does not imply a universal finite-sample capture ordering against global trust. Report the requested contrast as measured rather than a guaranteed sign.
choices.heldout: W1 two switch situations; equal average. All policies including oracle use beta3 own-utility softmax; copy frequencies renormalized on offered options, uniform only if no observed offered choices.
choices.library: Six distinct vectors. Separable top two pieces serve both positive ends; bundled top two each serve a positive end and .5 of the negatively valued end. Piece labels permuted per world. Seven distinct pair swaps sampled without replacement.
choices.omission: Remove every candidate source vector with the true third coordinate; correctly specified joint and outcomes-only retain the identical eight-library prior.
choices.source_grid: Eight signed vectors in uptake.SOURCE; aligned=(1,1,-.5), partial=(1,1,.5), opposed=(-1,-1,.5).
choices.training: W1 four-situation cycle, beta 3; noisy three-end vector every fourth choice, independent sd .5.
choices.trust: Beta(1,1) counts utility above maximum prior-expected piece utility; source-frequency mixture with own prior policy.
